combo_label: Sleep & Dreams × Birds & Birdwatching × Alice in Wonderland

entries.clue: Cliff-ledge seabird named for the cry it screams all day long
Heathland summer visitor that churrs at dusk and hawks for moths
Grey statue in the shallows that waits, stabs, and swallows the fish whole
Sudden fright, or the seven o'clock ring that causes it
Long-eared tea-table host whose springtime madness is proverbial
Milliner for whom it is always six o'clock and always time for tea
Short sleep in the afternoon; also the raised pile on velvet
Cheeky one-eyed signal; forty of them add up to a decent rest
Sleep rough or bed down anywhere; also, to laze about doing nothing
White chessman in armour who keeps tumbling off his horse and singing
Go round and round, as the toves do in the wabe
Small acrobatic garden bird: blue, great, coal or long-tailed
Grey writing tablet the twelve jurors scribble their own names on in court
The appointed hour when small children are packed off in pyjamas
